recipe.title: Through a seasonal chart
recipe.use: Exploratory graph-flight camera study; not accepted for reuse.
recipe.description: A camera weaves along a time axis between rising thin blue bars on one upright 2D chart grid, then lifts into a complete overview.
recipe.copy: Keep dates, values, axes and qualifications native. Perspective appearances are not a common screen-space scale.
recipe.metaphor: Original fictional values: [52,31,44,27,63,48]. A nonmonotonic six-period example; height reveal is animation, not an observation. Draft, not accepted.

motion.frameConvention: zero-based half-open; endpoint at frames is baked but not encoded
motion.limitations: Authored qualitative pose timing, not measured time or a new simulation. Holds and loop seams require rendered review.

encoding.note: Preserve Blender display sRGB transfer; convert RGB to limited-range BT.709 YUV.
